Name: (CP) Quartz Rock Candy
Author: Mady0
Description:
[b][color=red][size=5]Ever wondered how/why Abigail eats Quartz and other minerals?[/size][/color][size=6][color=red]
[/color][/size][/b][size=3]Wonder no longer. Any minerals you find will now be rock candy instead.

Four variants, one for each mineral, with an option to toggle if you want them to be call rock candy and have a matching description or if you want the base game name and description.
 
Thank you so much to [/size][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/SSyl/about-me?gameId=1303][size=3]SSyl[/size][/url] for making [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11151]Rename Mayo to Custard[/url]﻿ and allowing people to use it. While I didn't take his code and pieced together my own it really helped with bug testing and ultimately led to my full vision being possible as I wasn't able to figure out what was going on with it. I'm still not sure, but it wouldn't have been possible without having this as a reference.

[size=3]Should be compatible with other asset mods, even full conversions. Just make sure this one is loaded after them, otherwise
they may overwrite it.

[color=#cc4125]Disclaimer:[/color] While I made this with 1.6 in mind and even tested it for 1.6 I was unable to get part of it to work on a current version of content patcher modder tools. It runs fine with the updated game and mod, but SMAPI will tell you it wasn't made for 1.6, so just [i]ignore [/i]that.
[/size]

Manifest.Description: Turns the minerals into rock candy.
